message.content:
I don’t have the ability to make live calls to external services such as VirusTotal’s API.  
To pull the “sub‑domains” relationship objects yourself you would hit the **VirusTotal v2** endpoint:

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v2/domains/{DOMAIN}/relationships/subdomains
    ?limit=10&cursor=abc
Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY>
Accept: application/json
```

Replace `{DOMAIN}` with `example.org` and `<YOUR_API_KEY>` with your real key (`my_api`).  

This will return JSON containing an array called `objects`. Each element has at least an `"id"` field plus optional context fields such as `"relationship_type"`, `"parent_id"`, etc., depending on what VirusTotal includes for that relation type.

If you prefer a cURL snippet:

```bash
curl -H "x-apikey: my_api" \
     -G --data-urlencode "limit=10" \
        --data-urlencode "cursor=abc" \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v2/domains/example.org/relationships/subdomains"
```

That response will give you exactly the list of related object IDs (plus whatever minimal metadata VirusTotal supplies). If you run into rate limits or pagination beyond the first page, adjust the `cursor` parameter accordingly.
